name: SVG Tech Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: SVG Tech Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and industrial operations of optoelectronic materials and devices in the fields of information photonics and advanced displays in China. It offers high end precision equipment, advanced photonic technologies and devices, automotive optics and intelligence, ultra-thin lighting and energy saving displays, AOM advances photonic materials, and reflective materials and radiative materials and radiative cooling materials. SVG Tech Group Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as SVG Optronics Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SVG Tech Group Co.,Ltd. in June 2018. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
